title: Recovery Integrity: projection rebuild permission must not become execution continuation

source.fixture: real SQLite + atomic JSON process-crash harness / after_authority_commit

falsifiableQuestion: Can a real process-crash RecoveryIntegrityRecord that permits projection rebuild cross ProofPath and CML while preserving HOLD for execution and transferring no authority?
negativeControls: Changing execution_continuation from HOLD to ALLOW_FORK must be rejected before the ProofPath bridge.
Changing the CML result to authorizesAction=true must prevent Recovery Receipt issuance.
Changing the source RecoveryIntegrityRecord after SCIG creation must fail source-digest binding.
nonClaims: This case does not prove arbitrary physical power-loss durability.
This case does not grant production recovery, mutation, or execution authority.
This case does not claim that Codex implements this recovery protocol.
ProofPath VALID and CML READY_FOR_AUTHORITY_CHECK are verification/readiness results, not execution permission.
